sources.snippet: Kokoro 82M TTS - Surgically Optimized for Apple Silicon 15 seconds of speech in 691ms on an M1 Mac Mini. 2.8x faster than Metal. Using Apple Neural Engine. Kokoro-82M running natively on the Apple Neural Engine via CoreML. Five compiled models, one Swift pipeline, zero Python at inference time. Every Mac with Apple Silicon is a TTS server.

sources.snippet: Kokoro-82M is a StyleTTS2-based neural text-to-speech model converted to CoreML for on-device inference on iOS 17+ and macOS 14+. It generates natural-sounding multi-speaker speech at 24kHz with 8-12x real-time performance, optimized for Apple Neural Engine (ANE) and GPU execution.
